vpn-tunnel-state.error: VPN tunnel failed: an error occurred

logout.error: An error occurred while logging out

daemon-no-compat: Daemon version is not compatible with the app version! Daemon version: {{version}}, expected: {{required}}. Please update either the app or the daemon.
daemon-not-connected: Can't connect to daemon. Restart the app or device. If this persists, reinstall NymVPN.
update-installed-restart-required: A new version of NymVPN has been installed. Please restart the app to apply the changes.

conflict-detected.intercepted-dns: Something on this system appears to be intercepting DNS queries, which may interfere with connectivity.
conflict-detected.competing-vpn: Another VPN client's tunnel appears to be active alongside NymVPN's, which may interfere with connectivity.
conflict-detected.competing-firewall: Another application's firewall rules appear to be positioned to intercept NymVPN's own network traffic, which may interfere with connectivity.
